acceptance_holds: The legacy four-hole saddle is fully encapsulated as an internal core: its two middle bores are filled, no alignment pins remain, and each left and right ear exposes exactly two accessible M3 paths.
The lower/first station is a 3.4 mm round clearance and the upper/second station is a nominal 3.4 x 5.0 mm capsule slot through both mating flanges.
Both mating flanges are broad, closed-manifold, deeply recessed, and continuously rooted into their owning shell. No connector may project onto the exterior mirror-panel landing.
M3 x 20 socket-cap screws, 7 mm washers, M3 nyloc nuts, driver envelopes, and nut-tool envelopes must have direct modeled paths.
Both ears must seat and remove along the modeled outward path without collision with the final V9 body, bridge, bezel, keel, socket-cap, or complete V0.5-M2 aluminum envelope.
The primary interface must be mirrored and support/brim-inclusive Prusa MK4 Generic ASA slicing must pass for both updated upper shells and both ears.

F-13/F-14 and A-11 remain open until the under-ear translucent insert is redesigned with its separate reinforced M2.5 outer anti-flap tie. The primary M3 interface must not pretend to close that finding.
